note: San Bernardino County regional park on the Mojave River between Victorville and Apple Valley, with Horseshoe Lake and Pelican Lake. The full-hookup RV loop sits on the west shore of Horseshoe Lake; the east-row sites face the water across a day-use strip. Tent sites line both lakes; fishing, boat rentals, disc golf and an equestrian center. --Claude
